paired_frontend_contract.equality_rule: frontend copy must be byte-identical to this authoritative backend contract
paired_frontend_contract.verification: compare raw bytes before joint acceptance

common.authentication: existing Bearer authentication; every stage rechecks the fresh actor, originating logical session, Root-only capability, target visibility, target state, role, auth version, policy version, and catalog version when applicable
common.path_guid: canonical positive decimal signed int64 string without sign, whitespace, or leading zero
common.strict_json: one exact JSON object; reject unknown, duplicate, case-folded duplicate, invalid UTF-8, trailing fields, and oversized bodies before service invocation

versions.expected_permissions_version: integer 0..9223372036854775807; zero is allowed only for promote when no target policy head exists; demote and permissions.write require a positive current version
versions.catalog_version: integer 1..2147483647 matching the current capability catalog

common.overrides: complete array of unique capabilities, each item an exact object with only capability and effect; effect is inherit, allow, or deny; canonical persistence omits inherit; reject unknown, unavailable, duplicate, case-folded duplicate, and allow on Root-only or ungrantable capabilities

response_headers.X-Request-ID: required non-empty; error body request_id equals this header

common.mutation_replay: never automatically replay Issue, POST execute, or PATCH execute; a 409 allows at most one owned refresh and requires a new user gesture

eligibility.actor: active Root with a current nonrevoked logical session and the exact effective capability; Admin overrides cannot obtain these capabilities
eligibility.promote_target: visible, nondeleted User in active or disabled state; never self or Root
eligibility.demote_target: visible, nondeleted Admin in active or disabled state; never self or Root
eligibility.permissions_target: visible, nondeleted Admin in active or disabled state; never self or Root
eligibility.stale_or_same_state: 409 with no security-version, session, policy, audit, outbox, or operation-result mutation

body.current_password: required independent owned UTF-8 bytes, cleared on every exit

header_rules.X-Action-Ticket: exactly one valid users.promote ticket bound to the path target and complete canonical intent

execute.success_rule: committed terminal result only; operation_commit_unknown is an error carrying operation_ref

query.query_rule: accept exactly scope=users.promote and no other query parameters
query.original_key_rule: required exactly once using the original mutation key

body.current_password: required independent owned UTF-8 bytes, cleared on every exit

header_rules.X-Action-Ticket: exactly one valid users.demote ticket bound to the path target and complete canonical intent

execute.success_rule: committed terminal result only; operation_commit_unknown is an error carrying operation_ref

query.query_rule: accept exactly scope=users.demote and no other query parameters
query.original_key_rule: required exactly once using the original mutation key

body.current_password: required independent owned UTF-8 bytes, cleared on every exit

header_rules.X-Action-Ticket: exactly one valid users.permissions.write ticket bound to the path target and complete canonical intent

body.action_literal: field absent; method and path select users.permissions.write

execute.success_rule: committed terminal result only; operation_commit_unknown is an error carrying operation_ref

query.query_rule: accept exactly scope=users.permissions.write and no other query parameters
query.original_key_rule: required exactly once using the original mutation key

schema.resulting_auth_version: positive INT32 equal to the single committed auth-version advance
schema.resulting_permissions_version: positive INT64 equal to the single committed policy-head advance
schema.resulting_role: user or admin as fixed by the exact scope

stable_result.storage_and_replay: store all five fields on the terminal operation and replay those stored values; never project the current user row

operation_query.nullable_result_rule: all four nullable result keys are always present; succeeded uses the stored stable result and processing, failed, and pending_recovery use null for every result key

succeeded.result_keys: all present from stored stable result

operation_query.visibility: only the originating actor, current originating logical session, exact scope, and original key can query; hidden or unverifiable combinations return 404 and expired or tombstoned results return 410
operation_query.refresh: a succeeded query authorizes one owned target detail and permissions refresh; query never triggers mutation callbacks or consumes begin rate limit

operation_commit_unknown_error.operation_ref: required only when code is operation_commit_unknown

header_rules.matched: Cache-Control no-store and nonempty X-Request-ID; admin_action_error request_id equals X-Request-ID
header_rules.Retry-After: required only for action_rate_limited and processing query; forbidden otherwise

frontend_security.ownership: closing or superseding the dialog clears current password, ticket, key, and unknown-state ownership; failed requests retain only nonsecret editor values and normalized reason

implementation_boundary: contract only; no route or consumer is claimed active and no implementation or acceptance is claimed complete
